performance_gate.rationale: Strict PR9 performance gates require every measured public command-WAL throughput lane to be greater than 1.01x of the legacy public cached WAL baseline. Current refreshed evidence passes that bar: point Set median is 1.074x with allocation parity, focused Batch.Write medians are 1.542x for batch_size=64 and 1.296x for batch_size=1024 with fewer allocations, and unified_bench batch_write is 1.219x on the median representative stats-scan run. The implementation keeps same-key command ordering, appends public batch command frames after cached preflight and before cached visibility, piggybacks AppliedCommandLSN publication onto cached checkpoint publication, and buffers trusted public command-WAL batch frames in writer-owned memory so digest/CRC/write finalization occurs at command-WAL flush/checkpoint boundaries instead of as a direct writev per batch.

mode_proof.typed_frames_note: end-of-run checkpoints covered and cleaned typed frames; applied_command_lsn proves 196 command frames were accepted and published
